hero.title: Full Stack Engineer
hero.subtitle: I turn complex ideas into simple, usable web apps.
hero.description: Passionate about building scalable applications and bringing ideas to life through code.
hero.bio: I’m a Senior Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience building products that people love to use. From sleek frontends in React and Next.js to scalable backends in Node.js and Python, I enjoy solving problems end-to-end. I’ve worked on everything from payment systems with PayPal and Stripe to high-volume data pipelines on AWS. Whether it’s deploying with Terraform, scaling with Redis, or mentoring teammates, I’m passionate about creating software that’s fast, reliable, and impactful.

footer.brandTagline: From concept to cloud - I ship it
footer.brandDescription: Senior Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience specializing in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and the MERN stack. Skilled in building scalable web applications, architecting cloud-native backends, and integrating payment systems. Passionate about delivering high-impact solutions and mentoring teams to achieve technical excellence.

donationPlatform.description: Led a 3-4 person team migrating a donation platform's backend from Strapi to Supabase, rebuilding its API layer with Next.js and Deno for better performance and maintainability.

civasource.description: Built an AI-powered product-matching system in Python and FastAPI, using Redis queues to process scraped product data at scale, with authentication throughout.

playertotals.description: A real-time player statistics platform built with Node.js and TypeScript, using Redis queues and MongoDB to process high-volume sports data with low latency.

forwood-safety.description: A safety-checklist management system built on a Node.js/TypeScript microservices architecture, including its AWS deployment pipeline and DevOps workflow.

alteraapp.description: Built the WebSocket communication layer and command/UI libraries powering AI agent behavior inside Minecraft, for Altera's AI research platform.

tradefundrr.description: A CRM platform built with Python, Flask, Django, and React - contributed core features, API testing, and sprint-based delivery in an agile team.

autotempest.description: A responsive car-search web app that filters and displays scraped listings from a MySQL database, built with React.js and a REST API for fast, flexible searching.

points-app.description: A web-based customer loyalty platform where users redeem points for mobile top-up codes, built with Node.js, React, and MySQL, with integrated payment processing.

al-khair-traders-pos.description: A full inventory and retail management system covering products, suppliers, purchases, sales, returns, and quotations, with role-based permissions down to the module level. Built with Node.js, Express, and TypeORM on the backend and React with TanStack Query on the frontend, including JWT authentication, versioned database migrations, and auto-generated API documentation.

deployment-tool.description: A final-year automation tool that converts N1QL (Couchbase) queries into Firebase Cloud Functions, streamlining data integration between the two platforms.
